builds.hypothesis: R3 direct shell is575+1.5 AD[statFormula=2]. High AD and physical penetration strengthen direct hit; cone separately uses440+1.2AD. Bloodthirster supplies80AD. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

kitEvidence.formula: Graves fires an explosive cartridge, blasting himself backwards. The cartridge deals [275 / 425 / 575 + (1.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit. After hitting an enemy champion or reaching the end of its range, the cartridge explodes outward, dealing [200 / 320 / 440 + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.
